page.overview:
What is Istasha?

Istasha is a fictional entity created by American author James Ambuehl for his 1990 Cthulhu Mythos poem "Where Walks Istasha". She is also mentioned in the 1997 short story "The Stalker in the Snows", which identifies her as a Great Old One.

A cat deity similar to Bast but more vicious, Istasha came to Earth long before the rise of humankind, and is worshiped by her Children in the Halls of Ulthar. Her sister is the sylvan Lythalia. (: "Where Walks Istasha", "The Stalker in the Snows")
